text: I feel energized and enthusiastic when I'm around other people, especially in lively group settings.
I tend to find fault with others and often end up arguing rather than letting things go.
I follow through on my commitments and stay organized and self-disciplined about getting things done.
I get anxious or upset pretty easily, even over small things that don't go as planned.
I actively seek out new experiences and enjoy exploring complex or unconventional ideas.
I tend to stay quiet and hold back in social situations rather than jumping into the conversation.
I go out of my way to be warm and supportive, and I genuinely care about other people's feelings.
I often lose track of things and tend to be careless or disorganized about details.
I stay calm and emotionally steady even when things get stressful or chaotic.
I prefer sticking to familiar, conventional ways of doing things rather than trying something creative or unusual.
